slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Weeks off, then a full day of tennis, and Toto's shoulder is twinging by Monday 🎾

A sudden jump in play is a common trigger for sore shoulders. Where you can, play a little more often rather than a lot at once, and warm up for five minutes before going full power.

Side-lying external rotations and band rows two or three times a week help the shoulder handle repeated swings. Start light, three sets of 10 to 15. Power comes from the legs and trunk, so hip and mid-back mobility helps too.

Pain that stops you sleeping on that side, weakness lifting the arm or pain lasting weeks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
